redfin.remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained gated townhome offering 2 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, a versatile bonus office area , and approximately 1,287 square feet of comfortable living space. Designed with a functional multi-level floor plan , the home features separate living and dining areas, creating an open yet defined layout that's perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The inviting living room offers a cozy fireplace , while the spacious kitchen opens to the dining area for easy gatherings. Upstairs you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, including a private primary suite, along with the convenience of an in-unit upstairs laundry room. The bonus office area provides an ideal space for working from home, a study, hobby room, or additional flex space to suit your lifestyle. Additional highlights include central heating and air conditioning, an attached two-car garage with direct access, and a private patio for outdoor relaxation. Residents enjoy a well-maintained gated community complete with a sparkling pool and spa. Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, parks, public transportation, and major freeways, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and value. Don't miss this wonderful opportunity to make this North Hills townhome your next home!
